Hi Aline — thanks for the clear note and the contract. We can handle this in one of two ways depending on what you prefer from an accounting standpoint:

Option A — Credit + Supplemental Invoice (recommended for bookkeeping):
- We issue a credit for the unused days at the original seat count for 1–4 June (if any overlap) and then create a supplemental invoice covering 5–30 June for the additional 12 seats.
- This yields an explicit credit note matched to the June invoice and a small supplemental invoice for the top-up.

Option B — Single Adjustment on next invoice:
- We post a single line item adjustment (negative or positive) on the July invoice reflecting the net apportionment for June.

VAT handling: if the VAT ID you supplied validates as an EU VAT-registered entity, we will apply reverse-charge (no French VAT applied by Redwood) and include the VAT ID on the credit/invoice. If the VAT ID does not validate, we must charge French VAT on the supplemental invoice.

Next steps from our side:
- Ben will run the apportionment calc and attach a provisional csv showing the math.
- If you confirm preference for Option A vs B and re-send any formal VAT registration doc (if you prefer), we can proceed.

I expect a provisional credit/invoice in 48 hours after Ben completes the calc.

Marissa / Aline — I ran the apportionment model. Posting the key bits inline and attaching the guideline PDF.

Policy + calculation approach (short):
1) We compute a daily per-seat charge by taking the monthly per-seat rate and dividing by the calendar days in the invoice month.
2) For seats added mid-month, we charge for the number of days active (inclusive of the activation date).
3) Credits for any deactivated seats are computed the same way and issued as a separate credit note tied to the original invoice.
4) For EU customers with a validated VAT number we mark the invoice with reverse-charge (no VAT applied). If not validated, standard French VAT rate (20%) is applied on the supplemental invoice/credit.

Example (illustrative only):
- Monthly seat price (list): €120/seat/month
- Daily rate = €120 / 30 = €4.00/day (we use actual days in month; June has 30)
- Seats added: 12 seats on 5 Jun => charge days = 26 (5th–30th inclusive)
- Supplemental amount = 12 * 26 * €4.00 = €1,248.00 (net)

If you prefer Option A, we will: 1) issue a credit note for any day-level overlap (if applicable), 2) issue a supplemental invoice for €1,248 (net), and 3) include reverse-charge notation if VAT validates.

I attached the apportionment-guideline.pdf which walks through the ledger entries we produce and sample journal notes for your finance team.
